title: The Lord on the Throne
summary: In the year that king Uzziah died, Nephi sees the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, with his train filling the temple. Seraphim stand above it, each with six wings.

explicit_facts.text: The narrator sees the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train fills the temple, in the year that king Uzziah died.
Above it stand seraphim, each with six wings: two covering his face, two covering his feet, and two used to fly.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The throne occupies an elevated position within the temple.
unspecified_visual_details: The Lord's facial features and other physical characteristics are unspecified.
The seraphim's number and appearance beyond the described wings, faces, and feet are unspecified.
Temple architecture, throne design, colors, and lighting are unspecified.
The narrator's position and appearance are unspecified.

narration.text: In the year that king Uzziah died, I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The supplied task explicitly identifies the first-person narrator as Nephi; these two verses themselves name him only as “I.”
King Uzziah's death establishes the year, not a separate visible event.
The Lord's seated appearance and the seraphim are explicitly described as seen.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Uzziah's death or place him in the temple.
Do not invent dialogue or additional events.
Do not add undescribed divine physical features or supernatural effects.
Do not add features to the seraphim beyond those stated.

title: The Seraph’s Cry
summary: One seraph cries to another; the doorposts move and smoke fills the temple.

explicit_facts.text: One seraph cried to another, declaring the Lord of Hosts holy and the whole earth full of his glory.
The doorposts moved at the voice of the one who cried, and the house filled with smoke.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Smoke is visible within the temple.
unspecified_visual_details: The smoke’s appearance and the temple’s design are unspecified.

spoken_dialogue.text: Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of Hosts; the whole earth is full of his glory.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: One seraph

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The earth being full of glory is part of the seraph’s proclamation, not a described visible event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the earth itself visibly filled with glory.

The seraph declared that the coal had touched the narrator’s lips, his iniquity was taken away, and his sin purged.
